`final class VulkanBackend`<br/>

**Package:** `dev.joid.backend.vulkan` · **Module:** `backend-vulkan` · **Source:** [VulkanBackend.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/backend/vulkan/src/main/java/dev/joid/backend/vulkan/VulkanBackend.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">Vulkan</span>

The backend for Vulkan, which records the frames of JOID into the frame of a Vulkan host and reads a GLFW window.

## Description

The host owns the device, the command buffers and the image that JOID draws into: [`WindowVulkanHost`](/reference/vulkan/windowvulkanhost/) for a window of your own, or your engine through [`IVulkanHost`](/reference/vulkan/ivulkanhost/).
The loop draws each JOID frame between `beginFrame()` and `endFrame()` of the host.

## Method details

<a id="VulkanBackend-method-destroy"></a>

### destroy

`void destroy()` 

**Throws:**

- `IllegalStateException`: VulkanBackend has no render bridge to destroy: call register() first and destroy() only once

Waits for the device, then releases every resource of the renderer; call it after the loop, before you destroy the host.
Throws an `IllegalStateException` before `register()` or on a second call.
